description: Use when: which BNB wallets keep buying early into launches that then run? Ranks wallets that bought in the first blocks and first buyers of four.meme and PancakeSwap launches that later reached about 2x and are still trading. Returns early hits, hit rate, sample tokens with entry time and an approximate multiple, and last seen. Drops routers, deployers and bundled snipers. Free BSC logs only go back about 2 days; lookback_hours is the span read. Cached. Partial if a source fails. Not advice. Costs $0.02.
name: bsc_smart_money
